page.title: Munea | Finally, someone remembers · AI health companion

persona.h2: Whoever you are, someone remembers you
persona.sub: A grandparent at home, a daughter far away, a grandchild who wants to be closer — senior companionship and family care, with a place kept for every one of them.
persona.1.q: Alone at home — her sore knee, her grandchild's wedding, her favourite old street. She wants someone to remember what she said, and to keep her company.
persona.1.p: Munea chats with her every day, keeps it all, and reminds her — gently, out loud — when it's time for her meds or a check-up. Nothing to memorise, nobody to trouble.
persona.2.q: Busy, far away, shy about calling all the time. She just wants to know Mom and Dad are okay today.
persona.2.p: She opens the app and sees how they're doing, and hears first when something is off — the worry from afar finally has somewhere to rest.
persona.3.q: He wants to be closer to grandma and grandpa — he just never knows what to talk about.
persona.3.p: A family walking challenge, a quick quiz game — the laughter does the talking, and three generations get a little closer.
pain.h2: Being cared for shouldn't wait for someone to be free
pain.sub: From the elder at home to the child far away, everyone is stuck on a quiet difficulty.
pain.1.h3: A whole day, and no one to really talk to
pain.2.h3: Did I take my meds? Is a check-up due?
pain.3.h3: Away, and unsure how Mom and Dad are today
pain.4.h3: Starting from "hello" every single time is tiring
features.h2: A health-care steward that lives in the family
features.sub: Watching over health and reminders, chatting as naturally as a video call, keeping the whole family connected — three things Munea does every day.
feat.1.alt: Munea app health data and reminders screen
feat.1.h3: Meds, check-ups, and the numbers — all watched over
feat.1.p: Munea watches over health for you — medication and check-up reminders arrive on your phone right on time, with steps, heart rate, blood pressure and sleep synced in from Apple Health.
feat.1.li1: Meds & check-up reminders — a notification right on time, no scolding if you slip
feat.1.li2: Health trends at a glance — steps, heart rate, blood pressure, sleep
feat.1.li3: Apple Health sync — brought in automatically, no manual logging
feat.1.li4: Push reminders — they still arrive when the app isn't open
feat.2.badge: As natural as a video call
feat.2.h3: A chat so natural, it feels like a video call
feat.2.p: As the family's care steward, Munea chats with your loved ones. Real-time voice and a live moving face make every conversation vivid, warm and natural — comfortable, just like a video call with family.
feat.2.li1: Real-time voice — jump in anytime, replies never lag
feat.2.li2: A moving face — looks at you and speaks, like someone's really there
feat.2.li3: Remembers what you said — picks up right where you left off
feat.2.li4: Says "I don't know" when she doesn't — never invents, never plays doctor
feat.3.h3: See how everyone's doing — and have fun together
feat.3.p: In the family care circle, everyone can see and look after each other's health and mood. Start a walking challenge or a quiz game together — little ways to add fun and closeness across generations.
feat.3.li1: Health & mood — visible to each other, peace of mind from afar
feat.3.li2: Walking challenges — the whole family competes on steps
feat.3.li3: Quiz games — keep Mom and Dad sharp, with more laughter
feat.3.li4: Speaks up when something's off — checks on them first, then tells the family

tech.h2: FamilyWellness AI — your family's health & care companion
tech.tag: The real-time intelligence that makes company feel truly present.
tech.intro: She isn't a general-purpose assistant — she's a care system where memory, perception, interaction and safety work together. This is what's underneath, and why she isn't like other AI.
arch.memory.p: Every conversation is distilled into four memory layers — core, long-term, recent, today — weighted by importance, newer facts replacing older ones.
arch.perception.p: Every morning she gathers weather, news, key dates and family updates in advance — building today's context before the conversation even starts.
arch.interaction.p: Interruptible real-time voice, a face whose expression and lip-sync track her voice to the millisecond, a character engine that swaps personality and voice, plus a safety layer that can veto any response.
arch.orch.p: All modules merge in real time into a single reply; priority always runs safety, then immediacy, then background — context injection stays minimal, and never steals the spotlight.
cmp.cap: How she's different from a general AI
cmp.1.a: A general assistant that answers anything
cmp.1.b: A care system where memory, perception, interaction, safety and personality work together
cmp.2.b: An expressive face and natural voice, live like a video call
cmp.3.b: A personality with character — switch her, switch the voice and rapport
cmp.4.b: Proactively builds today's context every morning
cmp.5.b: Never diagnoses; medication is only ever a reminder; says so when she doesn't know
cmp.6.b: Not a long-term care system — built for the whole family’s physical and emotional wellbeing
tech.close: FamilyWellness AI — real technology built to do one simple thing: remember you, understand the moment, and respond to you well.
faq.sub: Worried about your parents but can't be there every day? Here's what people want to know before they download.
faq.1.q: My parents live alone and I'm far away. What's a good way to look after them?
faq.1.a: Have your parents install Munea, install it yourself, and join the same family health circle. Whenever they feel like talking, an AI companion chats with them by voice, remembers what they've shared, and reminds them about medicine and check-ups on time. When you open the app, you can see the health and mood updates they choose to share. What you can see is always up to them.
faq.2.q: Is there an app that reminds older parents to take their medicine?
faq.2.a: Munea does. Set the medication times in the app and a notification arrives right on time, even when the app is closed. You can set check-up and appointment reminders too, and a missed dose never brings a scolding. Munea only reminds; it never evaluates or changes medication. Always follow your doctor's and pharmacist's instructions.
faq.3.q: What is Munea, and who is it for?
faq.3.a: Munea is an AI health companion app for iPhone, made for the whole family. Older parents chat with an AI companion by voice and get medication and check-up reminders. Adult children far away join the family health circle to see how their parents are doing day to day. It is not a long-term care system or a medical device. It's a companion for everyday family health.
faq.4.a: Munea is free to download, and new accounts get 5 trial credits (1 credit is about 1 minute of conversation). There are two paid plans: Plus includes 100 credits a month and a family health circle of up to 4 people; Pro includes 200 credits a month and up to 12 people. In Taiwan, Plus is NT$599 a month and Pro is NT$1,199 a month, with yearly plans also available. The price shown in the app is what you pay. You can buy extra credits anytime, and subscriptions renew through the App Store and can be canceled at any time.
faq.5.a: No. Nina and Milo are Munea's AI companions: illustrated characters with AI-generated voices. They tell you plainly that they are AI, never pretend to be human, and never impersonate a member of your family.
faq.6.q: Are my conversations recorded? How is my privacy protected?
faq.6.a: Your voice is encrypted and processed in the cloud only to understand what you say. Raw audio recordings are not kept; only key points of the conversation are saved so she can remember you next time, and you can view or delete them anytime under My data in the app. Your data is never sold or used for ads. Family members only see the status and summaries you allow, and full transcripts are not shown to them by default.
faq.7.a: The person who created the family health circle (the circle owner) taps Invite family on the Family tab to get an invite code and sends it to a relative. The relative downloads Munea, signs in, taps Join the family health circle on the Family tab, and enters the code. Inviting family requires a paid plan: up to 4 people on Plus and up to 12 on Pro, including the owner.
faq.8.a: No. Munea does not diagnose, prescribe, or give treatment advice, and it is not an emergency service. What it does is keep your loved ones company, remind them about medicine and check-ups, and help you see day-to-day health changes. For any health concern, please see a doctor or pharmacist.
final.p: Free to download. Plans and prices are shown inside the app. Currently available on the Taiwan App Store only.
foot.desc: The Munea App — an AI health steward that remembers you. A face that moves, a voice that remembers, keeping you and your family close. Not a long-term care system, just senior companionship and family care that live in the everyday.
foot.disclaimer: Munea is a companion for company and daily reminders. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or emergency medical services. For health concerns, consult a doctor. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.
